segments.sn17.11:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati … pe …“dāruṇo, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko … pe … adhigamāya.
segments.sn17.11:1.3: Idhāhaṃ, bhikkhave, ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi –
segments.sn17.11:1.4: ‘na cāyamāyasmā suvaṇṇapātiyāpi rūpiyacuṇṇaparipūrāya hetu sampajānamusā bhāseyyā’ti.
segments.sn17.11:1.5: Tamenaṃ passāmi aparena samayena lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūtaṃ pariyādiṇṇacittaṃ sampajānamusā bhāsantaṃ.
segments.sn17.11:1.6: Evaṃ dāruṇo kho, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko … pe … evañhi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabban”ti.

lines: 167-168. Dutiyavaggassa paṭhame sampajānamusā bhāsantanti appamattakenapi kāraṇena sampajānameva musā bhāsantaṃ.
“Sīlaṃ pūressāmī”ti saṃvihitabhikkhuṃ sinerumattopi paccayarāsi cāletuṃ na sakkoti.
Yadā pana sīlaṃ pahāya sakkāranissito hoti, tadā kuṇḍakamuṭṭhihetupi musā bhāsati, aññaṃ vā akiccaṃ karoti.
